name: novacart
description: NovaCart: full-stack e-commerce (React Native app, admin dashboard and REST API)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,admin,mobile" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:mobile"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix admin && npm run build --prefix admin
scripts.start:all: concurrently -n "backend,admin,mobile" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:mobile"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix admin && npm install --prefix mobile
